name: Agapé Plastics, Inc.
old_description: Founded over 50 years ago, Agapé Plastics remains a family-owned, WBENC-certified manufacturer rooted in precision, accountability, and long-term partnerships. What began as a regional injection molding operation has grown into a vertically integrated, automotive-grade manufacturing partner serving Tier 1 suppliers and industrial OEMs across North America.
about:
Agapé Plastics, Inc. is headquartered in Walker, Michigan. The company was founded in 1973 and remains family-owned and WBENC-certified as a woman-owned business. What began as a regional injection molding operation has grown into a vertically integrated, automotive-grade manufacturing partner serving Tier 1 suppliers and industrial OEMs across North America.

The company provides custom injection molding, insert injection molding, in-house tool room and mold design, reverse engineering, metal-to-plastic conversion, post-mold assembly, plastic welding (including sonic and infrared welding), manufacturing and assembly, plastic part design optimization, and injection mold tooling services. Operations run on 48 injection molding machines ranging from 85 to 1,560 tons of clamping force within a 144,000-square-foot facility that operates 24 hours a day across three shifts with approximately 230 employees.

Agapé Plastics primarily serves the automotive industry, supplying Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs with safety systems, steering column components, NVH components, and complex interior and exterior assemblies. Beyond automotive, the company works with heavy-duty truck and commercial vehicle manufacturers, agricultural equipment producers, hand and power tool brands, renewable energy and industrial equipment companies, as well as the appliance, furniture, RV and marine, and powersports sectors.

The company emphasizes engineering-led, vertically integrated program management from quote through tool build and production launch, with leadership directly involved in operations. Its quality systems are built to IATF 16949:2016 and ISO 14001 standards, featuring in-house CMM inspection and process validation. WBENC certification supports supplier diversity initiatives for customers.

name: Akron Steel Fabricators Inc
old_description: Our worldwide experience in developing and manufacturing custom equipment makes ASF the place to turn to for proven OEM machinery solutions and fast response to custom fabrication needs. You'll get the superior engineering and manufacturing capabilities that you can count on.
about:
Akron Steel Fabricators (ASF) was established in 1946 in Akron, Ohio, as an innovator in the tire and rubber industries. Now operating as a division of the Poling Group, the company runs a 42,000-square-foot facility on Manchester Road that houses design, engineering, fabrication, and assembly under one roof.

The division provides custom CAD design and engineering through to finished machinery, specializing in rubber handling equipment. Its product lines include calenders and ancillary equipment, mill blenders, slab cutter/feeders, batch-off machines for mixing operations, and the next-generation S2S Series Slitter for cold slab stock cutting. ASF also builds OEM machinery solutions and offers machine remanufacturing, calibration, installation, and on-site support.

ASF serves the tire, rubber, plastic, and steel industries worldwide, with a strong presence in automotive testing. Customers range from original equipment manufacturers needing proven machinery to plants requiring custom fabrication and spare parts for existing lines.

The company emphasizes that its deep industry knowledge and in-house engineering staff allow it to build a high level of reliability into every machine, delivering fast response to custom fabrication needs and proven OEM solutions.

name: Alaska Packaging
old_description: Alaska Packaging Inc. specializes in innovative packaging solutions for perishable items. Our products are designed to ensure the freshness and integrity of shipments, with all packaging materials FDA approved for safety and compliance. Ideal for industries like fishing and agriculture.
about:
Alaska Packaging Inc. was established in 2002 in Anchorage, Alaska. The company operates as a provider of packaging solutions specifically engineered for perishable commodities.

Its product line consists of packaging materials that carry FDA approval for safety and compliance, designed to maintain the freshness and structural integrity of shipments throughout the supply chain. The firm also offers tailored fulfillment services, adapting packaging and logistics to individual customer requirements. No public data is available regarding facility square footage, employee count, or annual production volumes.

The primary markets served are commercial fishing and agriculture, sectors where temperature-sensitive and time-critical shipments demand reliable containment. Examples include packaging for fresh seafood and perishable produce.

Alaska Packaging differentiates itself through a focus on innovation in perishable-item packaging, combining regulatory compliance with customized fulfillment to reduce spoilage risk and meet stringent industry standards.

name: Alcam Metal Distributors
old_description: ALCAM Metals has been providing the Denver community with a wide variety of metals and fabrication services since 1994. Since day one, our goal has been to provide high-quality, timeless materials alongside exceptional customer service. In fact, many of our current customers have been with us since 1994 and keep coming back because they know us, like us, and trust us to meet their metal requirements.
about:
Alcam Metal Distributors, based in Golden, Colorado, has served the Denver metropolitan area since 1994. The minority‑owned company began as a metal distribution center and incorporated in 1999, later moving to its current facility off I‑70 and Ward Road in 2009.

The company operates as a one‑stop shop for metals including carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, brass, Fibergrate fiberglass gratings, and Indital ornamental components. Its services span distribution, custom fabrication (cut‑to‑length, MIG/TIG welding, braking, bending, milling, CNC plasma cutting, and shearing), CAD design with finite‑element analysis, shop drawings, and installation. A 2015 expansion added a dedicated steel supply and fabrication center, and a fleet of trucks provides delivery across the Denver metro region.

Alcam’s project portfolio centers on public‑works and commercial construction. It supplied and installed structural and miscellaneous metals for RTD Fastracks lines A, B, G, N, R, and W, as well as Denver Union Station. Current work includes projects at Denver International Airport and the Denver Center for the Performing Arts, alongside other public and private contracts in the region.

The company emphasizes rapid response, offering same‑day turnaround on rush orders, and stresses long‑term customer relationships — many clients have remained since the 1994 founding. Its differentiation rests on broad material availability, in‑house design and fabrication capabilities, and a minority‑owned certification that supports supplier‑diversity goals.

name: All American Woodworks/CST
old_description: All American Woodworks was founded on the principles of loyalty, trust, honesty and integrity. Our team understands how important your trust is, which is why we always strive to earn trust and deliver top-quality results no matter how large or small the project is.
about:
All American Woodworks operates from Emigrant, Montana, just outside Yellowstone National Park. The company was founded in 1996 by Steve Sirois, a third-generation New England craftsman who served with the 82nd Airborne in Iraq and Afghanistan, earning a Bronze Star for building housing and shower facilities for soldiers. After his military service, Sirois met his future wife Christine, began contracting in Nevada, and relocated the business to Montana in 2007. The shop is veteran-owned and family-operated, with Christine co-managing operations.

The shop specializes in custom CNC carving, furniture making, cabinetry, mantles, built-in bookcases, media wall cabinets, pet beds, and custom EcoPoxy epoxy creations. It also serves as an authorized retailer for EcoPoxy resins and a dealer for CabinetParts.com hardware. All pieces are designed and fabricated in-house, from initial consultation through final finish, and can be shipped anywhere in the continental United States. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

Customers range from residential homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind furniture, live-edge tables, and decorative carvings to commercial clients needing custom built-ins, office libraries, and branded fixtures. The company also serves military and patriotic markets with challenge-coin cases, badges, and memorial pieces, and supplies pet products such as hardwood kennels and beds. EcoPoxy products are sold to DIYers, artists, and professionals nationwide.

Sirois founded the business on principles of loyalty, trust, honesty, and integrity, emphasizing guaranteed one-of-a-kind craftsmanship and customer satisfaction. The shop's veteran ownership, third-generation woodworking heritage, and partnership with the "Made in Montana" program are cited as key differentiators, along with its authorized status for EcoPoxy and CabinetParts.com.

name: Alliance Wire & Cable
old_description: has been serving The Electrical, Datacom and Specialty Contractors in the Southeast region since 1998. Whether it is Fire Alarm Cable, Security Alarm Cable, Coaxial Cable, Cat 5E or Cat 6, Fiber, Medium Voltage Cable, Solar Cable PV Cable or Tray cable, we have what you need when you need it. Headquartered in Lawrenceville, Georgia just outside of Atlanta, Alliance Wire & Cable maintains an extensive inventory to serve our customers anywhere in the United States, the Caribbean and Mexico.
about:
Alliance Wire & Cable was established in 1998 in Lawrenceville, Georgia, when Sergio Marti and Mike Strong combined their experience in wire and cable distribution to serve the metro Atlanta area. The company is privately owned and headquartered just outside Atlanta.

The company operates as a distributor of wire and cable products, maintaining an extensive inventory that includes fiber and copper assemblies, pre-terminated cables, connectivity products, raceway and wiring duct solutions, and a range of specialty cables such as fire alarm, security, coaxial, category, fiber optic, medium voltage, solar PV, and tray cables. From its Georgia facility and a second location opened near Dallas, Texas in July 2016, Alliance serves customers across the United States, the Caribbean, and Mexico.

Its customer base spans electrical, datacom, and specialty contractors in the Southeast, as well as commercial, industrial, and residential sectors. Specific industries served include energy management, renewable energy (wind and solar), and industrial automation. The company supplies products for applications ranging from building wire and access control to variable frequency drive cables and motor lead wire.

Alliance differentiates itself through a focus on customer service, which the founders credit for early growth and expansion. Partnerships with manufacturers enable competitive pricing on quality products, while the dual-location model allows broader inventory availability and faster fulfillment. The company states it is committed to maintaining high service levels while adapting to evolving market conditions and technology.

name: American Microsemiconductor, Inc.
old_description: Incorporated in 1972, American Microsemiconductor, Inc. has been supplying semiconductors and other discrete active electronic components to major industrial accounts worldwide for four decades. The company specializes in all semiconductor components for commercial, industrial and high reliability military and aerospace clients. American Microsemiconductor is also a solution provider for obsolete-but-critical application integrated circuits for the replacement and repair of existing, vital electronic systems – helping to extend the life of our customer’s products. We are staffed primarily by sales and logistics professionals who will ensure that your requirement maintains a low lead-time, fair price, and efficient delivery.
about:
American Microsemiconductor, Inc. was incorporated in 1972 in Madison, New Jersey. The company began as a supplier of semiconductors and discrete active electronic components to major industrial accounts worldwide.

The firm operates as both a manufacturer and distributor of electronic components, specializing in diodes, thyristors, transistors, and optoelectronics. It maintains an inventory of over 500,000 items and offers access to more than 2,000,000 electronic parts, including obsolete and hard-to-find integrated circuits such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. The staff consists primarily of sales and logistics professionals who manage a supply chain monitored for reliability and risk. The company reports that 95 percent of deliveries ship overnight with no line-item minimum.

Customers span commercial, industrial, medical, military, and aerospace sectors. The company serves major industrial accounts globally, providing components for high-reliability applications and supporting the repair and life extension of existing electronic systems.

American Microsemiconductor emphasizes personal customer relationships, promising to know each client by name and understand their business needs. Its quality assurance program is registered to AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015, aiming to exceed expectations for product quality, delivery, authentication, and price. The company also highlights its communication channels—phone, fax, email, online chat, and Skype—as part of its service model.

name: American Pasteurization Company
old_description: American Pasteurization Company provides High Pressure Processing (HPP) to the food and beverage industry on a pay-as-you-go basis, co-manufacturing of many premium food products, and post-HPP packaging, pack-off and assembly services. Founded in 2004, APC was the first company to offer HPP on a commercial tolling basis to the food and beverage industry and has been steadily expanding our customer offerings and locations throughout our 17 years in business.
about:
American Pasteurization Company (APC) was founded in 2004 in Wauwatosa, Wisconsin. The company began as the first provider of High Pressure Processing (HPP) on a commercial tolling basis to the food and beverage industry, offering a pay-as-you-go model that lowered the barrier for manufacturers to adopt the technology.

APC operates as a contract processor and co-manufacturer, delivering HPP services alongside post-process packaging, pack-off, and assembly. The company also provides product development guidance from concept through commercialization and refers customers for refrigerated transportation. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual throughput are not disclosed.

The company serves food and beverage manufacturers across categories including ready-to-eat meats, plant-based proteins, fresh poultry and pork, sausage, seafood, egg-based products, dairy, beverages such as wheatgrass juice and energy drinks, and avocado-based items like guacamole. Customers range from emerging brands to established producers seeking extended shelf life and food safety without thermal pasteurization.

APC differentiates itself through its pioneering tolling model, which allows clients to access HPP without capital investment in equipment. The firm emphasizes its SQF certification and its role in guiding clients through packaging selection and regulatory considerations for HPP-treated products.

name: Arcadia Mfg Group
old_description: Arcadia Manufacturing Group has been in business since 1969 and is a skilled industry leader in contract manufacturing and fabrication services. We have the knowledge and versatility to handle a wide range of projects and industries across the USA. We will work with you from the early stages of your project right through completion. From design and budgeting all the way to manufacturing, inspection and delivery of the final product.
about:
Arcadia Manufacturing Group was founded in 1969 by James T. Sumner in Green Island, New York. Sumner began the business from his living room and the trunk of his car, supplying drills, taps, and saw blades. In 1979 his son William Sumner joined the company, and together they expanded it into a premium metals service center offering specialty metals, cutting tools, and precision cutting services. Today the company operates as a registered veteran-owned small business with two facilities totaling 88,000 square feet.

The group provides full-service, in-house contract manufacturing of fabricated metal parts, components, and assemblies. Its capabilities span waterjet cutting (multi-head tables up to 144 by 286 inches), laser cutting (Trumpf fiber lasers up to 1-inch thick carbon steel), CNC machining (4-axis vertical and horizontal centers holding ±0.0005-inch tolerances), certified welding (GMAW, GTAW, stud and plasma processes), fabrication (rolling, bending, punching, drilling, saw cutting), and assembly (sub-components, full assemblies, kitting). Design engineering and project management support round out the turnkey offering.

Arcadia serves customers across the transportation, architectural, infrastructure, energy, medical, military, defense, and construction industries throughout the United States.

The company traces its differentiation to the founding principles of superior customer service, a passion for metals, and a willingness to tackle difficult challenges. Its veteran-owned status and full-service, under-one-roof model are presented as key advantages for clients seeking a single-source partner.

name: Arkansas Poly & Printing
old_description: Nearly 50 years ago, APP began as a manufacturer of clear polyethylene bags, primarily in the poultry industry. As we grew, we recognized an opportunity to serve other industries with our expertise. Today, we engage in the extrusion, printing and converting of our own raw materials. The vertical integration of our production process allows us greater control over our scheduling, shortens lead times, and affords us opportunities to expand our market area.
about:
Arkansas Poly & Printing (APP) was established in 2001 in Van Buren, Arkansas, when partners Sarah Sparks Diebold and R. Trent Goins acquired a legacy polyethylene bag business that traced its roots to the early 1970s. The original founder, Ben Gosey, started with a single used bag machine, selling by day and producing by night, and later expanded into printing and extrusion operations in Fort Smith before consolidating in Van Buren.

Today APP operates as a vertically integrated custom flexible packaging manufacturer on a 10‑acre campus with 68,000 square feet of production space and a 5,000‑square‑foot office. The company extrudes its own film — offering LDPE, LLDPE, MDO, multi‑layer, PCR, biodegradable and compostable grades — prints up to 10 colors on flexographic presses equipped with AVT scan and ColorCert technology, and converts the printed web into bags, pouches, liners, sleeves and wicketed products through slitting, rewinding, folding, laminating, zip‑lock and gusseting. Additional in‑house services include graphic design, plate making, inventory management, warehousing and a private fleet for shipping.

APP serves the poultry industry — its original market — as well as broader food and beverage processors that require SQF and Global Food Safe certified packaging. Its customer base spans regional, national and international accounts seeking custom poly bags, films, liners and retail merchandise bags.

The company emphasizes vertical integration as its core differentiator, citing control over scheduling, shorter lead times and the ability to recycle 100 % of ink, scrap film and corrugated material. Quality systems include a HACCP‑based process, internal testing, and a reported product return rate below 1 %.
